answers.rationale: The requirement specifies ratings and features typical of medium-voltage switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is a metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear that meets these specifications, including the required current and momentary ratings.
This requirement pertains to compliance with contract documents and does not specify a product. It is a commercial requirement to be addressed by the bid manager.
The detailed construction and safety features described align with the CROWN-ARMV product, which is designed as arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear with customizable features.
The requirement specifies features and construction details for heavy-duty utility service switchgear, which are consistent with the capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV product.
The nameplate requirement is part of the switchgear specification and would be included in the scope of the CROWN-ARMV product, as it is a standard feature for such equipment.
